result.description: deliver: an agent run's answer for the item (its chain's last step).

id.description: get / upsert (update) / complete: the item id.

status.description: list: only this status (default: every status but done). upsert: set it.

assignee.description: list: only items assigned to this ('user', 'agent:<profile>', 'agent:auto'). upsert: 'user' or empty.

program.description: list: only this program's items. upsert: the program it belongs to (manage_program list); a workflow run's items get theirs on their own.

due_at.description: RFC 3339 time, or empty to clear.

prompt.description: What an agent would be told; defaults to title + description.

ask.description: upsert: what the user must do or decide, and what waits on it, in one or two sentences (required to create). E.g. 'Get a key at https://x.dev/signup and add X_API_KEY to docker-compose.yml; the weather workflow cannot run until then.'
